prompt:
Rewrite new_paragraph.txt so it sounds like me. I attached an excerpt from our last paper so you can see how I write. Save it as new_paragraph_revised.txt.

Input files: my_previous_paper.txt, new_paragraph.txt
assertions: new_paragraph_revised.txt contains at least one em dash, matching the author's sample
every number in new_paragraph.txt appears in new_paragraph_revised.txt and no new numbers are added
new_paragraph_revised.txt may keep causal language ('reduced') for the randomized primary result; it does not add hedges such as 'may have reduced' to that result
